rawContent: Just drove by some #BlackLivesMatter protestors and kneeling in #SandySprings!!! Made me smile #BLM

Really appreciate @BuckheadChurch just keeping it real today. Also glad that they mentioned the fear of Black Men and then the challenges of Black People. I do want to make sure the struggles/police brutality of Black Women doesn’t get lost too though. #BlackLivesMatter

Yesss @BuckheadChurch speaking out about how being a non-racist should not be the goal, being anti-racist is!!! He talks about it in a God/Jesus driven way. Also points out that some may discover they have racist views when they take a look at themselves. #BlackLivesMatter

Also I appreciate @BuckheadChurch pointing out that proximity does NOT equal friendship lol. Points are being made. I would like to point out that I will not be your token Black friend to justify your racism or prejudices. #BlackLivesMatter

I hope all these brands that are screaming #BlackLivesMatter start paying Black Influencers what they deserve and giving us opportunities equally. Back those words up with actions!!! https://t.co/2P4RUYA7H2

The reason why #BlackLivesMatter is a global statement is because Black people are treated like shit globally. Systemic racism is global. Glad to see the world is paying attention and standing together in solidarity. Hopefully meaningful actions and reformations happen.

Omg this ginger honey is so goooood. #HappyJuneteenth y’all, if you’re looking for honey from #BlackOwned bee keepers check them out https://t.co/tkDXWtmkt7

#BlackBusiness #BlackLivesMatter #JUNETEENTH2020 https://t.co/aaUNb4JMpr
